tasks.CheckSolution: Verify if the solution satisfies all given conditions.
tasks.DefineVariables: Define the three digits of the number as variables a, b, c where a is the hundreds digit, b is the tens digit, and c is the units digit.
tasks.FormulateEquations: Formulate equations based on the given conditions: 1) a + b + c = 17; 2) a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = 109; 3) (100a + 10b + c) - 495 = 100c + 10b + a
tasks.SolveEquations: Solve the system of equations to find the values of a, b, and c.
